test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question: The dietary fibres behave like a sponge because they:

options.text: can absorb water and swell up
prevent the absorption of trace metals
increase the motility of the small intestine

solution:
The correct answer is '**can absorb water and swell up**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The third sentence of the second paragraph says "***They have the property of holding water** and because of it, **these get swollen and behave like a sponge** as these pass through the gastrointestinal tract*''. (दूसरे पैराग्राफ का तीसरा वाक्य कहता है, उनके पास पानी धारण करने का गुण है और इसके कारण, ये सूज जाते हैं और स्पंज की तरह व्यवहार करते हैं क्योंकि ये जठरांत्र संबंध
